nodes.label: v0.5.4.1 Design: List-Card Ergonomics & Split-Pane Parity
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.rationale: Design specification ratified in Linear S-257 (map S-256) resolving detached checkboxes, pixel-bound list widths, stacked search card layouts, and TUI/WebUI split-pane and sorting divergence.

nodes.label: Unbreakable Name-Checkbox Unit
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.rationale: Binds checkbox, status indicator, and ellipsis-truncated skill name inside a single nowrap flex unit (.skill-title-unit / .result-title-unit) and height=1 TUI rows so narrow panes down to 10% never detach checkboxes from their labels.

nodes.label: Proportional 10%-50% List Width & Legacy Pixel Migration
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.rationale: Stores UiPreferences.listWidth as a 10..50 integer percentage (null = 35%) shared across WebUI --list-col and TUI panes; normalizes legacy v0.5.4 pixel values (> 50) to null instead of clamping to 50% so upgrades do not distort existing user layouts.

nodes.label: Contiguous Right-Justified Action Group (.result-foot)
nodes.source_location: ### Alternative B: Use a JavaScript `ResizeObserver` to Toggle `.result-actions` Between Lines
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.rationale: Uses declarative CSS Flexbox (.result-source with margin-right:auto and .result-actions with flex-wrap:nowrap + margin-left:auto inside .result-foot) to merge actions onto the penultimate line when wide and drop them together flush right when narrow, rejecting ResizeObserver to avoid drag layout thrash.

nodes.label: TUI Split-Pane Search & 3-Mode Sort Parity
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.rationale: Converts SearchBody to a two-pane split keeping Results and install list (N) in the left scrollbox (preserving Tab navigation and 80-col pty-smoke invariants rather than using a modal), adds Detail Panel with sibling sourceSkills discovery, and adds 3-mode sort cycling (checked -> name -> load) with memoized visibleResults.
